tutorial.title: Environmental Acoustic Intelligence
tutorial.subtitle: From Acoustic Perception towards Context-Aware Sound Intervention
tutorial.arc: Acoustic Perception → Contextual Understanding → Context-Aware Reasoning → Purposeful Sound Intervention

presenters_line: Prof. Woon-Seng Gan · Dr. Ee-Leng Tan · Mr. Jun-Wei Yeow (NTU Singapore)

lab.name: Smart Nation TRANS Lab
lab.school: School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

abstract.text: This tutorial examines how machines can detect, interpret, and act on information in an acoustic environment. We begin with sound event localization and detection (SELD), from modern spatial representations to label-efficient learning and language interfaces such as open-vocabulary SELD, text-queried localization, and spatial question answering. We then consider how acoustic scene classification (ASC), sound event detection (SED), and SELD can be integrated so that sound events are interpreted in relation to the scene in which they occur. The second half focuses on sound intervention: AI-assisted active noise control, soundscape augmentation, and intelligent sound management for hearables.

items: Explain how Sound Event Localization and Detection (SELD) builds spatial acoustic perception by identifying what happens, when it happens, and where it occurs.
Compare label-efficient learning approaches for SELD and explain how language interfaces make spatial perception open-vocabulary and queryable.
Explain how Acoustic Scene Classification (ASC), Sound Event Detection (SED), and SELD integrate to form Contextual Understanding.
Discuss how AI-assisted Active Noise Control addresses nonlinearity, slow adaptation, acoustic-path variation, and generalization.
Explain how Soundscape Augmentation moves beyond noise reduction towards positive acoustic environments.
Discuss Intelligent Sound Management for hearables as a programmable, adaptive, and human-aware form of Context-Aware Action.
